newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott Services sees revenues rising.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott Services sees revenues rising.

text.p: Host Marriot Services Corp said Wednesday it expects to generate $2.0 billion in annual revenues within the next five years as it expands into new markets like airports and shopping malls.

"We expect to build on our ...1996 performance and continue solid growth in earnings and cashflow," it said. "We think this puts us on track toward achieving our corporate goal of generating revenues of $2.0 billion within five years.
"We further anticipate that 25 (percent) of total revenues will come from new markets such as international airports and food courts in shopping malls by that time," it added.
Host Marriott reported revenues for the fourth quarter totaling $392.5 million against $358.6 million for the same period last year.
For the last 53 weeks ended January 3, revenues reached $1.3 billion, compared to $1.2 billion during the 52-week period ended December 29, 1995.
Host Marriott also reported a share profit in the fourth quarter of $0.03 against a loss of $2.13 a year ago.
